title: WeatherCore: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common WeatherCore failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If weather feels random, start logging forecasts before routes. If a base is constantly exposed, change the base or route instead of fighting every storm manually.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If weather feels random, start logging forecasts before trips. If a base is constantly punished, change layout or route timing instead of fighting every storm.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
